## Review Checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the approved scope.
- [ ] TDD red-green-refactor order was followed for behavior changes.
- [ ] Tests verify behavior rather than private implementation details.
- [ ] Domain boundaries remain explicit.
- [ ] Coupling is low and cohesion is high.
- [ ] Pythonic design was checked.
- [ ] Security and reliability impacts are addressed or documented.
- [ ] Infra and deployment impacts are addressed or documented.
- [ ] UX impact is addressed or documented when user-facing behavior changed.
- [ ] No unnecessary abstraction or broad refactor was introduced.
- [ ] Fresh verification evidence is included above.
